scripts.build: npm run build -w @ondaluz/api && npm run build -w @ondaluz/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @ondaluz/api" "npm run dev -w @ondaluz/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ondaluz/api && npm run test -w @ondaluz/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ondaluz/api && npm run lint -w @ondaluz/web
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run compose:check && npm audit --audit-level=moderate
